scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,admin -c blue,magenta "yarn workspace web dev" "yarn workspace admin dev"
scripts.build: yarn db:push && yarn db:generate && yarn workspace web build && yarn workspace admin build
scripts.build:prod: yarn db:push && yarn db:generate && yarn workspace web build && yarn workspace admin build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,admin -c blue,magenta "yarn workspace web start" "yarn workspace admin start"
scripts.clean: rm -rf .next && rm -rf node_modules/.cache && rm -rf apps/web/.next && rm -rf apps/admin/.next
scripts.clean:win: if exist .next rmdir /s /q .next & if exist node_modules\.cache rmdir /s /q node_modules\.cache & if exist apps\web\.next rmdir /s /q apps\web\.next & if exist apps\admin\.next rmdir /s /q apps\admin\.next
scripts.clean:cache: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dirs=['.next','node_modules/.cache','apps/web/.next','apps/admin/.next']; dirs.forEach(d=>{ try{ fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('✅ Eliminado:',d); }catch(e){} });"
scripts.fresh: yarn clean:win && yarn install && yarn workspace web dev
scripts.fresh:unix: yarn clean && yarn install && yarn workspace web dev
scripts.dev:clean: yarn clean:cache && yarn workspace web dev
scripts.dev:fresh: yarn clean:cache && yarn workspace web dev
